# Chickadee

> Disposable GitHub Actions runners with GitHub sign-in and scoped service API tokens.

Humans sign in with GitHub, install the App, select repositories and create a
named token at /settings/tokens. Agents use CHICKADEE_TOKEN as a Bearer token on
/api/v1/. Tokens are read-only by default, repository-scoped, revocable, and expire
after a chosen 1–90 days. Never send credentials to another origin or print them.
GitHub schedules jobs; this API manages service requests and queue configuration.
Requested state and applied runner availability are different. Use enabled labels.
Organization-wide policy controls require browser owner setup; API v1 covers
personal and existing legacy single-repository services.

## Agent documentation

- [Agent API guide](/agents.md): Authentication, human onboarding, complete endpoint examples, bounded polling, errors and safe workflow setup.
- [OpenAPI description](/openapi.json): Machine-readable service API v1 schema.
- [Human setup guide](/agents): Browser onboarding and token setup.
- [Create or revoke tokens](/settings/tokens): Requires human GitHub sign-in; token values are shown once.

## Optional

- [Roost source and issues](https://github.com/plover-digital/chickadee-roost): Public implementation and portable deployment documentation.
- [Standalone Chickadee](https://github.com/plover-digital/chickadee): Self-hostable runner engine, usable without a hosted-service account.
